theme_strategy: Light mode primary. The aesthetic is 'Premium Editorial'. Background is warm off-white (#F7F3F0) providing a soft canvas for high-contrast charcoal typography (#2D2D2D) and blush pink (#E8B4B8) accents.

rules.h1: font-['Clash_Display'] text-5xl md:text-[8vw] leading-[0.9] tracking-tighter uppercase text-[#2D2D2D]

visual_enhancers.borders: Use sharp, 1px solid borders using the Charcoal color at 15% opacity (border-[#2D2D2D]/15).
visual_enhancers.shadows: Avoid heavy drop shadows. Use subtle, diffuse shadows only for floating elements like the sticky ATC or cart drawer: shadow-[0_20px_40px_rgba(45,45,45,0.08)].
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use pure white (#FFFFFF) for product cards and high-focus elements against the warm off-white (#F7F3F0) background.
visual_enhancers.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full). Default state: bg-[#2D2D2D] text-[#F7F3F0]. Hover state: bg-[#E8B4B8] text-[#2D2D2D] with scale-up text. Add data-testid to all buttons.

layouts_and_grids.hero: Massive lifestyle image overlay. Max overlay bg-black/20. Text must be positioned creatively (e.g., bottom left or overlapping the image edge).
layouts_and_grids.bento_benefits: Bento 'Tetris' Grid (Mode A) for the benefits section. Mix tall image cells (col-span-1 md:col-span-4 row-span-2) with wide text cells (col-span-1 md:col-span-8). Padding p-8 to p-12 inside cards.
layouts_and_grids.product_grid: Editorial layout. Avoid uniform squares. Use aspect-[3/4] for product images. No visible container borders, let the image act as the card. Text flows cleanly below the image.
layouts_and_grids.spacing: Hyper-generous spacing. Use py-24, py-32 for section padding. Gap-8 to gap-16 in grids.

motion_and_interactions.smooth_scroll: MANDATORY: Implement lenis smooth scrolling for that premium 'momentum' feel.
motion_and_interactions.kinetic_hero: Use framer-motion for a line-by-line masked reveal. Wrap each line of 'Sculpt Your Shape. Elevate Your Confidence.' in an overflow-hidden span, and animate the text from y: '100%' to y: '0%'.
motion_and_interactions.parallax: Apply a subtle framer-motion useScroll and useTransform to the hero image and the UGC gallery images to create depth as the user scrolls.
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Product images should have a slow, subtle scale (scale 1.05) on hover. Buttons should transition colors smoothly.

components.header: Sticky glassmorphism navigation (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#F7F3F0]/80). Minimalist layout: Logo center, links left, cart/search right.
components.marquee: Use react-fast-marquee. Slow speed. Background #E8B4B8 (Blush pink), Text #2D2D2D. Font Clash Display text-4xl uppercase.
components.cart_drawer: Slide out from right. Sharp edges. Use Shadcn Sheet component customized to fit the brand colors.
components.toast: Use Sonner for Add-to-Cart notifications. Position bottom-right.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the application using React (.js files, no .tsx), Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion.
Implement Lenis for smooth scrolling in App.js or index.js.
Create a massive kinetic typography hero section. Animate lines individually.
Implement the products using sample data mirroring a Shopify API response structure for future integration.
Construct the Manifesto section using the Tetris bento grid strategy, numbering the chapters (01, 02, 03).
Use Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for clean, high-end editorial iconography.
Add 'data-testid' to all interactive elements, links, buttons, and form inputs for testing purposes.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Do not use generic centered layouts. Aim for optical balance and asymmetry.
Use 2-3x more spacing than typical templates to create a luxurious feel.
Absolutely NO pure transparent backgrounds in overlays/headers where text is present. Use glassmorphism.
No default browser scrollbars. Hide them or style them beautifully.
Ensure hover states exist for EVERY clickable element (change color, scale, or opacity).
